subject: Consulting sandbox acculturation & immersion journey
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@edgeworks.consulting>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Consulting sandbox acculturation & immersion journey

Hi Maya —

Great to reconnect after last week's partner planning call. As discussed, we put together a short 'immersion pathway' tailored for consultancies that are integrating with Redwood: a 4-week sandbox + guided shadow sessions + a lightweight certification check to validate deliverables. The goal: make your team independently productive in pilot engagements within 30 days while giving our field teams confidence in handoffs.

Attached: a quick access guide for your sandbox, the immersion syllabus, and a draft joint roadmap for the MVP. Highlights: 
- Week 0: sandbox provisioning + account mapping (self-serve + one-hour ops walkthrough)
- Week 1–2: joint solution labs (hands-on, 3x 90-min sessions)
- Week 3: shadowed mini engagements (paired delivery with an EDGE use-case)
- Week 4: certification quick-check & readiness review

Ask: can you confirm the set of engineers/consultants you want enrolled (max 8 seats for the initial cohort) and preferred kickoff week? We can start provisioning sandbox access the same day you confirm.

I'll leave Laura and Sergio on copy to align on schedule and the technical validation checklist.

Thanks,
Camila
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Sandbox-Access-Instructions.pdf, Immersion-Syllabus-v1.md, MVP-Joint-Roadmap.xlsx

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@edgeworks.consulting>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Riley <devon.riley@brightops.io>
Date: 2027-05-30T13:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consulting sandbox acculturation & immersion journey

Camila — thanks, this looks great. EdgeWorks is excited about a structured path like this. A few quick items from our side: 

1) Intended cohort: myself, Devon Riley (lead systems engineer), Priyanka Shah (NLP lead), and four delivery consultants I’ll nominate by Monday.
2) Preferred kickoff: week of June 7 would work best (client calendars open up that week).
3) One ask: can we include a short session for our pre-sales architects on existing Redwood routing and fallback policies? They’ll need that to scope engagements accurately.

If June 7 works, please provision sandbox access and send calendar invites for the joint solution labs. We can sign the mutual MOU after the first lab if that helps get us moving.

—Maya
Principal Partner Lead, EdgeWorks Consulting

Laura

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@edgeworks.consulting>
Date: 2027-05-31T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consulting sandbox acculturation & immersion journey

Thanks — drafting the validation checklist now. Draft outline below: 

- Environment sanity: API keys rotated, proper model pins, region routing configured.
- Latency smoke: run three 1k-token traces, median latency < target for your region.
- Inference correctness: run 10 eval prompts from the joint prompt set, F1/ROUGE thresholds met or documented variance.
- Security readiness: KMS integrated for any customer-owned keys and basic audit logging enabled.
- Handoff artifacts: sample runbook + one annotated prompt set for the chosen use-case.

I'll send the formal checklist by June 2 and include a short rubric for redlines. Would be helpful if EdgeWorks can also list 2 pilot customer scenarios (use-case + target SLOs).

—Sergio

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@edgeworks.consulting>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consulting sandbox acculturation & immersion journey

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Two pilot scenarios we propose: 

A) Customer support summarization pipeline for a mid-market SaaS customer — target: 200ms median per-request inference in the pilot region, 95% uptime for the test window.
B) Assisted code review assistant for an internal engineering org — target: high-precision extraction of TODOs and security flags (precision > 0.9 on a 100-sample baseline).

We’ll confirm names for the four delivery consultants tomorrow and prepare the sample prompt set. Looking forward to the ops walkthrough on June 8.

—Maya
